name: netstkovf
description: A netintr that runs off its 1024-byte stack halts through _fcc_stkoflow with the report naming that stack's floor, instead of writing into the slot pages below it. Only means anything at kernel.netprobe = 2.  The release /etc/rc less the network modules (fixtures/rc.netlate) is staged, so the command's modload is what loads them.
command: modload bsdnetd bsdnet0 bsdnet1 bsdnet2 bsdnet3; echo NOT''REACHED

requires.reason: the overflowing hook is compiled in only at kernel.netprobe = 2
